site.title: Awesome AI Architecture
site.tagline: Curated by failure mode, not vendor category.
site.description: A curated, opinionated map of AI infrastructure tooling, organized by the specific failure mode each tool addresses — with an explicit exclusion criteria, not an exhaustive link dump.

articles.title: Watchtower and Moat
articles.hook: Agent security isn't a tool choice — it's a layering problem. LLM-layer guards and runtime sandboxes solve different failure modes. Pick one, you get a speed bump. Stack both, you get an architecture.

articles.title: Smoke Signals in Production
articles.hook: Multi-agent frameworks aren't ranked by what they build—they're ranked by what you can see when they break.

articles.title: Where the Sandbox Ends
articles.hook: Every sandbox you deployed is theater if your LLM guardrails can't stop the prompt that makes the agent ask the sandbox to do the wrong thing.
